note: Zoom on the giant abacus counting corner of the sky-blue counting room, chequered floor (cartoon style). The abacus stands against the back wall; zero and 11 to 19 stand apart on the floor in counting order, left to right, zig-zagging between a back row (0, 12, 14, 16, 18) and a front row (11, 13, 15, 17, 19). Each one is grounded with its own shadow; nothing stands on a shelf. Numbers have no gender (divider null). The blank card on the wall is the sign.
